reason: A is the better proposal because it targets genuinely dynamic rates and offers a physically plausible, rate-dependent transition with measurable strength and serration predictions, whereas B assumes without support that Co removal increases lattice distortion and lowers stacking-fault energy and tests only up to 0.1 s⁻¹. A remains imperfect because its low-rate dynamic-strain-aging claim conflicts with the cited absence of serrations at 10⁻³ s⁻¹ and post-mortem TEM alone would not decisively establish phonon drag.
